description: Start a safe, governed autonomous loop from a plain-language goal. Use when the user says /coco-loop, "run an autonomous loop", "keep my build green for N hours", "work on X autonomously for a while", or wants a bounded self-improving loop that proposes fixes and never commits on its own. Turns a vague goal into a readable charter the user confirms, then arms and runs the loop propose-only under the coco-loops governance framework.
